title: DeadlineDefinition
description: PACK-09, ADR-041. Owned by compliance-service (epd2_compliance_service.domain.DeadlineDefinition). A reusable deadline template owned by one organization. timezone is an explicit IANA name (e.g. 'Europe/Berlin') and is REQUIRED: due-date arithmetic is performed on that civil clock and never silently assumes UTC. An empty or unknown zone is a fail-closed refusal (DEADLINE_TIMEZONE_UNDETERMINED). No field here carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a document or its bytes, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13). Natural persons appear only as per-case party references minted by epd2_compliance_service.domain.mint_case_party_reference, which resolve to nothing inside or outside this service.
